title: Wonderful Wares
description: A collection of models that include plants, plushies, food, furniture, and fandom themed mobs/items!!
body:
# WONDERFUL WARES
**INFO**
Wonderful Wares is a collection of different decoration themed blocks, foods, and weapons!
It also includes a sortment of fandom themed items! 
**All Currently Included Fandoms:** 
- Orb
- Hello Kitty 
- Pikmin
- FNAF
- Tattle Tale
- Poppy Playtime
- Undertale

This mod is still in early stages and the mod page will get a nicer makeover down the line! 
Thanks for any support for the mod!

This was made via MCreator
